name: Image Interpretation (VLM captions / VQA / screen)
purpose: Interpret one image with a local vision-language model and return a free-text interpretation (caption / detailed description / answer to a question / screen summary). Runs the already-staged llama.cpp llama-server (b8661) in multimodal mode (-m <vlm.gguf> --mmproj <projector.gguf> -> /v1/chat/completions with an OpenAI-style image_url base64 data URI), the same engine model.gateway (#7) drives, extended with the projector. Resolves the VLM from models.json (type=vlm), decoupled from the gateway wired gate. Binds a loopback port + CUDA/VRAM, so parallel_safe:false. Populates confidence (completeness+refusal+non-empty heuristic) + model_provenance and routes low-confidence / refusal / empty interpretations to the review queue (seventh producer). Composes capture.screen (#6) via -Capture and image.util (#15) via -MaxDimension (downscale before sending). Default model vlm.qwen2p5-vl-3b (Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct GGUF Q4_K_M + mmproj, Apache-2.0).

invocation.args_spec: Named params -InputFile <path> (image; required unless -Capture); -Prompt <question/instruction>; -Mode <caption|describe|vqa|screen> (default resolved from prompt/capture); -System <system prompt>; -Model <model_id> | -Tier <alias>; -MaxTokens <n> (512); -Temperature <0..2> (0.2); -TopP <0..1> (0.9); -Seed <n>; -ConfidenceThreshold <0..1> (0.5, review floor); -MaxDimension <n> (downscale via image.util before sending); -Capture; -CaptureInputsJson '<json>'; server knobs -Context/-GpuLayers/-Port/-LoadTimeoutSec; overrides -Registry/-ModelPath/-MmprojPath/-EnginePath/-ImageUtilPath/-CapturePath/-PythonPath/-PwshPath/-ReviewQueuePath; test seam -VlmResponsePath <captured.json>. OR -InputsJson '<json {input,prompt,mode,system,model,tier,max_tokens,temperature,top_p,seed,confidence_threshold,max_dimension,capture,capture_inputs,context,gpu_layers,port,load_timeout_sec,registry,model_path,mmproj_path,engine_path,image_util_path,capture_path,python_path,pwsh_path,review_queue_path,vlm_response_path}>'. Optional -ArtifactRoot, -InvocationId.

inputs.name: input
inputs.description: Path to the source image (anything the VLM/data-URI accepts: jpg/png/webp/bmp/gif). Required unless capture=true.

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.description: Question or instruction. Used verbatim when given (selects mode=vqa unless a mode is named); otherwise a per-mode default is used.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: caption (one sentence) | describe (detailed; default for a file) | vqa (answer -Prompt) | screen (screen-oriented default; default with -Capture).

inputs.name: system
inputs.description: System prompt (default: a concise, factual visual-assistant instruction).

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: VLM model_id in models.json (type=vlm). Default = defaults.vlm (vlm.qwen2p5-vl-3b).

inputs.name: tier
inputs.description: VLM tier alias resolved via tiers.vlm. A named -Model wins.

inputs.name: confidence_threshold
inputs.description: Envelope confidence below this routes the interpretation to the review queue (verify_interpretation).

inputs.name: max_dimension
inputs.description: When set and the image's longest side exceeds it, downscale via image.util (Module 15) before sending, to bound vision tokens.

inputs.name: capture
inputs.description: When true and no input is given, compose capture.screen (Module 6) to produce the image, then interpret it.

inputs.name: capture_inputs
inputs.description: Inputs object passed to capture.screen when capture=true (default: primary monitor).

requirements.gpu: cuda (RTX 2080 Ti; VLM runs on GPU)
